comparison.objective: Brake a coasting flywheel before entering its guard zone, keep it restrained while unscrewing its clamp nut, and place the nut in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate a sprung friction-brake lever, verify zero speed, sustain restraint against wheel rotation, unscrew a threaded nut and transfer it safely.
comparison.success_condition: Wheel below 0.15 rad/s before approach, nut unscrewed by at least two turns and removed, then released upright in the tray while the wheel remains stopped and the brake returns up; premature guard-zone entry zeros the trial. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Both tasks involve counterholding and a nut, but this record tests stored-energy braking and threaded fastener removal from a rotating assembly, whereas the candidate tests preserving an adjustable stop while tightening a jam nut and verifying retained motion.
